title: Golden v1 evidence
description: Raw observations collected by one run. Evidence states what was seen and never why. It carries the identity of the run that produced it so a result cannot be assembled from another run's captures, and it carries its own capture time so re-evaluation cannot restamp it.

run_id.description: Identity of the run that captured these observations. The evaluator rejects evidence whose run_id differs from the manifest's, which is what makes wrong-run assembly detectable rather than silent.

captured_at.description: When the observations were collected. Distinct from evaluated_at, which belongs to the result. Writing evaluation time here republishes old evidence as current on every re-run.

observations.description: Field name to observed value. Keys are the fields assertions name. Values are raw: a status code, a count, a duration. A verdict is not an observation.

collector.description: What produced these observations, for provenance.

trust.description: primary is captured directly from the platform. derived is computed from primary. reported is taken from a summary and is the weakest, because a summary can disagree with the raw records it claims to describe.

incomplete_fields.description: Fields the collector attempted and failed to capture. Naming them keeps an absent field distinguishable from a field that was never attempted, so absence stays INCONCLUSIVE rather than being read as a refutation.
